title: Usage Credit and Low-Use Surcharge on Self-Pay Visit Package Reinstatements
content:
**Fee schedule — usage, Self-Pay Visit Package reinstatement.** The engagement credit and the low-use surcharge follow the visits used on the package: a **$5.00** engagement credit is credited where at least half of the visits purchased were used, a **$5.00** low-use surcharge is added where fewer than a quarter were used, and neither applies otherwise. The engagement credit is subtracted from the reinstatement charge; the low-use surcharge is added to it.

**Visits used.** The package visits drawn at attended appointments, as the package history records them, compared with the visits purchased on the package.

**Thresholds for the tiers that offer reinstatement**

| Tier | Visits purchased | Engagement credit at | Low-use surcharge at | Neither |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Core 8-Visit Package | 8 | 4 or more used | 0 or 1 used | 2 or 3 used |
| Complete 12-Visit Package | 12 | 6 or more used | 0 to 2 used | 3 to 5 used |
| Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package | 18 | 9 or more used | 0 to 4 used | 5 to 8 used |
| Comprehensive 24-Visit Package | 24 | 12 or more used | 0 to 5 used | 6 to 11 used |

**Boundary readings (hypothetical, 12 visits purchased)**

- 6 used: half of 12 — the engagement credit applies.
- 5 used: neither.
- 3 used: a quarter of 12 is 3, and 3 is not fewer than a quarter — neither.
- 2 used: fewer than a quarter — the low-use surcharge applies.
